title: Verify special encounter descriptor through the packed owner
changes: Add a controlled original importer-prefix check using a source-authenticated descriptor-1 encounter template and trace its shared physical row through the existing packed-lookup owner.
Clarify that the descriptor-1 row was unowned at e81 but its physical bytes are covered by the later e97 resource, without creating duplicate ownership.
validation: Wine e158-special-descriptor-alias-fix-wine-56wpztn8 passes interpreter and translated prefix comparisons with the template and row bytes poisoned: one typed row request, no raw requests in selected spans, and identical complete state and clock.

The authenticated EUR catalog has 2601 descriptor-1 templates; this is a source count, not proof of ordinary reachability. The first Wine unit c8t9zyf0 failed because the test left the trace frame unset; it drained the server. Corrected Windows build _vmlafdt and Wine unit passed.
limitations: Only one controlled prefix and one template are executed; ordinary invocation, full importer behavior, other alias consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
